examples.english: "When I joined the Wanderers last April I was told that in Ormeño's latest contract, he had been warned that it would be his last, so I could justifiably start looking towards the future," the spokesperson explained in a conversation with Valparaíso's El Mercurio, further sustaining that the winger "knew that there would not be a renewal in December".
examples.ref: 2015 December, “Juan Gutiérrez se defiende y le cierra la puerta de Santiago Wanderers a Jorge Ormeño”, in Emol:
examples.text: "Cuando llegué a Wanderers en abril pasado se me informa que en el último contrato realizado a Ormeño se le había advertido que sería el último, para que justamente comenzara a ver lo que iba a hacer en el futuro", explicó en diálogo con El Mercurio de Valparaíso el personero, además sostuvo que el volante "sabía que en diciembre no iba a existir una renovación".
examples.translation: "When I joined the Wanderers last April I was told that in Ormeño's latest contract, he had been warned that it would be his last, so I could justifiably start looking towards the future," the spokesperson explained in a conversation with Valparaíso's El Mercurio, further sustaining that the winger "knew that there would not be a renewal in December".
